name: NoAutoPause
description: Disables Minecraft's automatic pausing: the client keeps ticking while its window is in the background, so HTTP-driven or otherwise unattended agents keep running. Only pauseOnLostFocus is cleared, so opening a menu in a single-player world still pauses the game the vanilla way. Standalone extraction of the noautopause behavior that MineAgentAIO carried inline; no Fabric API dependency.
